2d •

Your employee may still be showing up.



Still meeting deadlines.

Still attending meetings.

Still doing the job.



But perhaps they are taking longer to make decisions.



Getting irritated more easily.

Finding ordinary tasks strangely exhausting.

Needing more time to recover after a demanding day.



From the leadership’s POV, these can look like performance issues.



But, from the individual’s point of view it’s:

“Why am I finding everything so difficult lately?”



Sometimes the question worth asking is not only:

“What is wrong with this person’s performance?”



But:



“What has happened to the capacity with which they are trying to perform?”



Modern stress doesn’t always stop people from functioning.



Sometimes it quietly changes how much functioning costs them.



And that matters because organisations don’t perform through policies, programmes or job descriptions.



They perform through human capacity.
